column1: # Filter traditions APPROVED by Dave (second decisions, 2026-10-27).

column4: Baptist churches (Southern Baptist, independent Baptist, Reformed Baptist and others): believer's baptism by immersion, the Lord's Supper as a memorial, local-church autonomy.
Methodist, Wesleyan, Nazarene and Holiness churches: Arminian on salvation, emphasis on holiness and Christian perfection.
Presbyterian and Reformed churches: Calvinist on salvation and election, covenant theology, infant baptism.
Lutheran churches: justification by faith alone, baptismal regeneration, the real presence of Christ in the Lord's Supper, Law and Gospel.
Assemblies of God, Church of God and charismatic churches: baptism in the Holy Spirit, spiritual gifts today including tongues and healing.
